title: Face Sculpt #115 · 일본 아이돌 · 놀란 · 양쪽 트임 8배+거대한 눈 · 각진 턱 · 메이크업 없음 · P50 · 종 모양 자므카형
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the long earrings fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Early 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult woman — deep ebony-brown skin with a rich warm undertone and a healthy glossy sheen, early 20s, long straight black hair with soft see-through bangs, vivid intense crimson-red coloured contact lenses with a heart-shaped pupil, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, eyes opened very wide with the whites showing above and below the irises, brows lifted high, lips parted in a round open O, staring straight into the camera, a startled, astonished expression — a photograph of a real Japanese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, and she wears no eyeshadow and no eyeliner at all): pure fantasy eyes, impossibly long, wide open and gigantic yet elegantly beautiful, with both corners opened to the extreme: the inner corners are fully opened with the small pink inner corners clearly visible, and the outer corners sweep across her temples, past her ears and into the hairline at the side of her head, so each eye opening is about eight times its natural length and also far taller and rounder than normal, two colossal, wide-open, long almond-shaped eyes with high arched upper lids running almost the whole width of her face, each filled with a huge round iris in the middle and a clean sweep of white on both sides, so the eyes look overwhelmingly bigger, not just longer, still graceful, perfectly symmetrical and beautiful; the outline of each eye is crisp and clean, defined only by her natural dark lashes and the edge of her lids, with no eyeshadow and no eyeliner; the eyes are in very large coloured doll-eye contact lenses with a glossy shine and a big iris, both eyes the same, with a round natural pupil and bright catchlights; her nose: a very steep, sharply sculpted surgical nose: a knife-like bridge that rises steeply and sharply from the brow, a needle-pointed tip projecting well forward, and very narrow, tightly pinched nostril wings with thin, slit-like nostrils; her jawline and chin: a strong, angular, square jawline: a wide, clearly defined, sharp-cornered jaw angle just below each ear, a broad flat chin with a slight cleft, hollow sculpted cheeks and very high, razor-sharp cheekbones. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about forty in total (not counting the hanging drops), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; two small hoop or studs along the edge of the upper lip; four small hoop or studs across the lower lip's edge; two small ring or studs on the chin; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the lower opening holding a huge dome-shaped bell earring as large as her palm, with rows of tiny gem and pearl drops hanging from its rim, hanging freely in the air down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the upper opening holding a large classic round hoop earring, and above them sit seven pieces above the lobe: four classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, two studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and one in the conch and tragus; five small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; four small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. Every piece on her face is bright and light-coloured, so that it gleams clearly against her deep skin: small polished gold and mirror-silver studs, rings and bars, and tiny clear diamonds and pearls. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. The face and ear jewelry is real polished bright yellow gold and mirror silver set with clear diamonds, white pearls and icy pale gems, every piece light and gleaming, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
